rules.name: Double Entry Ledger Verification
rules.description: Every member deposit or loan repayment must create balanced debit and credit ledger rows.
rules.recommendation: Debit cash/bank account and credit member savings/share capital atomically.

rules.name: Member Passbook Audit Trail
rules.description: Never update historical ledger balances without generating an immutable audit record.
rules.recommendation: All passbook adjustments require supervisor approval and an audit trail entry.

rules.name: Bengali Currency Formatting
rules.description: Receipts and balance summaries must display amounts in BDT (৳) with Bangla numeral option.
rules.recommendation: Use locale-aware BDT formatting with optional Bangla numerals (১২,৩৪৫ ৳).
